offer.title: New device, quick tour?
offer.body: You've had the CatRealm tour before, but not on this device. Want a quick look around?

steps.title: Welcome to CatRealm
steps.body: A quick look at where everything lives. You can skip it any time.

steps.title: Home
steps.body: Your friends, direct messages and group chats live here. Click it to come back from any server.

steps.title: Friends and notes
steps.body: Your notifications and friends list, adding friends, and your personal notes.

steps.title: Discover servers
steps.body: Browse public servers here and join any that look fun.

steps.title: Your conversations
steps.body: Switch between direct chats and group chats.

steps.title: Join a server
steps.body: Join a realm with an invite, or connect to a server by its address.

steps.title: Mic, sound, privacy and changelog
steps.body: Mute or deafen yourself, open your privacy dashboard, and see what's new.

steps.title: Your profile
steps.body: Your name and status. Click it any time to edit your profile.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click the settings cog to continue.

steps.title: Main Profile
steps.body: How you appear across CatRealm: picture, banner, display name, bio and status.

steps.title: Add a profile picture
steps.body: Click your avatar to upload one.

steps.title: Add a banner
steps.body: Upload a banner for the top of your profile card.

steps.title: Server Profiles
steps.body: Use a different picture or banner on specific servers. Your main profile is the fallback.

steps.title: Account Security
steps.body: Your signed-in devices, passkeys and security keys.

steps.title: Voice
steps.body: Microphone and speakers, and voice activity or push to talk.

steps.title: Notifications
steps.body: Mobile push notifications, and the sounds for messages, calls and voice.

steps.title: Appearance
steps.body: Themes, custom themes, and how heavy the animations are.

steps.title: Emotes
steps.body: How large emotes appear, plus your personal emotes.

steps.title: Desktop
steps.body: Open on startup, minimise to tray, and opening links inside CatRealm.

steps.title: Updates
steps.body: Check for updates and pick your update channel.

steps.title: Time Format
steps.body: A 12 or 24 hour clock.

steps.title: Language
steps.body: The language CatRealm uses on this device.

steps.title: Streamer Mode
steps.body: Hide personal information and mute sounds while you stream or record.

steps.title: Content & Social
steps.body: NSFW filters and the link domains you trust.

steps.title: Cat Lab
steps.body: Experimental features. Fun, but use them at your own risk.

steps.title: You're all set
steps.body: You can replay this tour from Settings whenever you like. Have fun!
